name: The Siren's Coral
label: Quest
description: The Siren's Coral: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take a look around you. The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash. Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to Azshara.

Specifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me. Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research. I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The spitelash sirens are surprisingly adept mages. Not as adept as you, I hope?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is a superb specimen of coral, friend. Your skills are unquestionably precise and deadly.
Do not think your efforts have gone unnoticed. Perhaps you are worthy of a true test of your skill...
